headline: Fort Lewis thin the division's unbeaten ranks at CSU Pueblo
dek: Midwestern State, Lincoln, Emory & Henry and Cal State LA are now the only programmes in the division yet to lose. Midwestern State kept their place among them with a draw at home to UT Dallas.
displaced_by: results night: CSU Pueblo's unbeaten start ended, leaving Midwestern State, Lincoln, Emory & Henry and Cal State LA as the division's only unbeaten programmes
